Ayush Shetty Defeats World No. 1 at Badminton World Championships

Indian badminton player Ayush Shetty defeated China's Shi Yu Qi, the reigning champion and world number 1, at the BWF World Championships 2026. Shetty's victory is described as a significant upset. Following his win, Shetty made statements about the achievement.
